game.title: inFAMOUS Second Son
game.blurb: Open-world superpower action game set in Seattle, from Sucker Punch Productions, released 2014-03-21 on PlayStation 4. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters follow the mission list on StrategyWiki's contents page (names only), grouped into a few parts.

chapters.title: The Opening Missions
chapters.summary: The first missions, from "Introduction" to "Parting of the Ways". Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Arriving in Seattle
chapters.summary: From "Welcome to Seattle" to "Chasing the Light": settling into the city and gaining new powers.

chapters.title: Taking Back the Districts
chapters.summary: Missions such as "Go Fetch", "Light It Up", "Trash the Stash" and "Fight Intolerants", alongside clearing districts.

chapters.title: The Middle Missions
chapters.summary: From "The Test" to "Flight of Angels". Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Final Missions
chapters.summary: From "Hunting the Hunters" to the last mission. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Karma and Powers
chapters.summary: Good and evil karma choices, karmic moments and the powers you unlock.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide under "InFAMOUS Second Son" at completion stage 0. Its Table of Contents lists 23 walkthrough missions (from "Introduction" to "Expose/Kill Augustine"), but none of those mission pages is written; only Controls, Powers, The Karma System, Trophy Guide and the Table of Contents exist. Chapter boundaries group those mission names and are a guess; mission names only, no text copied. infamous.fandom.com has no page under "inFAMOUS Second Son" but answers under "Infamous: Second Son" (found with the API's search), with about 91 linked pages, including "Side Missions in inFamous: Second Son" and "Infamous: Second Son/Trophies"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. No Steam app (steam=None), so there is no achievement list.
